# betterado_project_pipeline_settings (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String)

### Optional

- `enforce_job_scope` (Boolean) Limit job authorization scope to current project for non-release pipelines
- `enforce_job_scope_for_release` (Boolean)
- `enforce_referenced_repo_scoped_token` (Boolean) Protect access to repositories in YAML pipelines
- `enforce_settable_var` (Boolean) Limit variables that can be set at queue time
- `publish_pipeline_metadata` (Boolean) Publish metadata from pipelines
- `status_badges_are_private` (Boolean) Disable anonymous access to badges
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
